source_text: ἢ κολοβόκερκον σφάγια ποιήσεις αὐτὰ σεαυτῷ· εἰς δὲ εὐχήν σου οὐ δεχθήσεται. Θλαδίαν καὶ ἐκτεθλιμμένον, καὶ ἐκτομίαν, καὶ ἀπεσπασμένον, οὐ προσάξετε αὐτὰ τῷ Κυρίῳ, καὶ ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς ὑμῶν οὐ ποιήσετε. Καὶ ἐκ χειρὸς ἀλλογενοῦς οὐ προσοίσετε τὰ δῶρα τοῦ Θεοῦ ὑμῶν ἀπὸ πάντων τούτων, ὅτι φθάρματά ἐστιν ἐν αὐτοῖς, καὶ μῶμος ἐν αὐτοῖς. Οὐ δεχθήσεται ταῦτα ὑμῖν.» Ἄθρει δὴ οὖν ὅτι παρεγγυᾷ σαφῶς καὶ ἀναφανδὸν ὁ νόμος, καὶ τοῖς ἐξ αἵματος Ἰσραὴλ, καὶ τοῖς ἔξωθέν τε καὶ εἰσκεκριμένοις εἰς λαοὺς, φημὶ δὴ τοῖς προσηλύτοις, τὸ χρῆν
pass_a_gloss: §4 dual gloss: ἄρσην / male · τυφλός / blind · γλωσσότμητος / tongue-cut … Pass A ≠ Pass B. Theme: Male unblemished = Christ; blind/crushed/tongue-cut manners.
pass_b_english: Cyril: …or dock-tailed you will make them slaughters for yourself; and unto your vow it will not be received. A crushed one and squeezed-out, and a eunuch, and pulled-apart, you will not bring them forward to the Lord, and upon your land you will not make. And from a hand of an alien-born you will not bring-forward the gifts of your God from all these, because corruptions are in them, and a blemish in them. These will not be received for you.’ So then observe that the law enjoins clearly and openly, both for those from blood of Israel, and for those outside and having been judged-into unto peoples, I say the proselytes, the needing to blemish-inspect very well the sacred things. For he said needing to be brought-up by us the male and unblemished, that is, the well-strong, and above passions; for the softness, and mindset the female-fitting, and indeed also the being sick with the inward and intelligible defect at least unto mind, is altogether unacceptable to God, and rejectable. Or do you not say unholy is the one for whom these would appear present?

Cyril: So then rejectable on the one hand the strengthless, and the as it were relaxed, and acceptable the well-strong, as being painted in a nature of males, if it should have yoked-beside the unblemished. And such would be unto a clear type for us of Christ. For male together and unblemished is Emmanuel, if at least he is truly power of God, and not knowing sin. And male also otherwise; for always preeminent, and in better things than the other is the male; and toward this at least also most leadership-holding. And he has stood-before and is incomparably in better things, and leads the wholes, even if the Son has become according to us, and the shepherd has been reckoned among sheep usefully. And unholy and sendable-away of the victims, blind, and crushed, and indeed also tongue-cut, and warted, and mangy, and lichen… So then the word upon each, and what would become clarify again.

Cyril: So then I am somehow also very eagerly. So then blind seems to say the unwise and unintelligent, and not having divine light in himself that is, the enlightenment through Christ in Spirit, and altogether unholy, the still mindless and unfaithful; ‘For if you should not believe, you will not understand,’ he says.
